[...]

[D24:20] Dave: Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots! The food in Tokyo is great, I'll have so much fun exploring all the different places. Have you tried ramen yet? Here's a photo of a ramen bowl that I tried in Boston, it was delicious, but i think in Tokyo it will be even better!
[D24:21] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Never tried it, but it's supposed to be awesome. Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo!
[D24:22] Dave: Do it, Calvin! Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!
